answer: Put time-locked reputation bond vesting over epochs at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. Cloning 529 keys multiplies the price 529-fold: 51842 POA locked, or 8464 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. One karst of signal, one shale of cost, one zephyr of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
